name: croc
summary: Command-line tool that transfers files and folders between two computers with end-to-end encryption, peer-to-peer with relay fallback.
use_cases: send files or folders between two computers
send short text or URLs to another computer
share a terminal session with others
store encrypted files temporarily for later download
features: transfer files between any two computers
send through a proxy such as Tor

capabilities.label: Send files or folders between computers
Receive files with a code phrase
Store encrypted files for later download
Pipe data via stdin and stdout
Show QR code for mobile receive
Transfer through SOCKS5 or HTTP proxy
Exclude folders or files from sending
Send and receive files in browser

setup.command:
mkdir -p /tmp/ct && cat > /tmp/ct/t.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# usage: t.sh MODE   (multi | wrongcode | resume)
set -u
MODE=$1; cd /tmp/ct; rm -rf src dst relay.log; mkdir -p src dst
export CROC_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1
R="--relay 127.0.0.1:9109 --disable-clipboard --no-update-check"
croc relay --ports 9109,9110,9111 > relay.log 2>&1 & RP=$!
sleep 2
echo "alpha file contents" > src/a.txt
echo "bravo file contents" > src/b.txt
CODE=7391-qzxv-plum-ferry
if [ "$MODE" = resume ]; then
  head -c 3000000 /dev/urandom > src/big.bin
  head -c 1000000 src/big.bin > dst/big.bin
  echo "receiver starts with partial big.bin: $(stat -c %s dst/big.bin) bytes"
  FILES="src/big.bin"
else
  FILES="src/a.txt src/b.txt"
fi
CROC_SECRET=$CODE croc $R send --transport relay $FILES > send.log 2>&1 & SP=$!
sleep 3
RC=$CODE; [ "$MODE" = wrongcode ] && RC=1111-wrong-code-here
(cd dst && CROC_SECRET=$RC timeout 60 croc $R --yes --overwrite 2>&1); ST=$?
echo "receiver exit: $ST"
kill $SP $RP 2>/dev/null; wait 2>/dev/null
echo "--- sender log ---"; tail -n 8 send.log
echo "--- received files ---"
if [ "$MODE" = resume ]; then
  echo "dst/big.bin size $(stat -c %s dst/big.bin)"; cmp src/big.bin dst/big.bin && echo "RESUMED FILE IDENTICAL"
else
  for f in dst/*; do echo "$f: $(cat $f)"; done
fi
[ "$MODE" = wrongcode ] && [ $ST -ne 0 ] && exit 0
exit $ST
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/ct/t.sh

pitfalls.actually_needed: Without root, run the installer with -p "$HOME/.local/bin", which the README documents as a custom prefix

On Linux, croc send --code fails with the message 'to send with a custom code phrase, you need to set the environmental variable CROC_SECRET'. The sender needs CROC_SECRET=code croc send ... (or croc --classic). The README mentions this elsewhere, but the --code example is shown with no caveat.
Not run: it queries GitHub releases, and the replayed smoke tests run with the network off

pitfalls.readme_said: p2p with relay fallback via the public relays
pitfalls.actually_needed: The checks used a local relay (croc relay --ports 9109,9110,9111) with --relay 127.0.0.1:9109 and --transport relay, so they work offline

judge.observed: Multi-file transfer delivered both files with correct contents, the wrong-code check shows the receiver failing with exit 1 and nothing received as intended, and the version check prints croc version 11.6.5.

features.feature: transfer files between any two computers

features.note: its check passed, but the output does not show it: Nothing in the output shows encryption, and the wrong-code check failed with an i/o timeout rather than an authentication rejection.
The receiver started with the first 1 MB of a 3 MB file and ended with an identical copy, but the output doesn't show that only the missing part was sent. No interrupted transfer was tested.
